description: List the legal document actions Mandate Office offers or is preparing, with status, audience, version, last_verified and updated dates. country returns only that country (unknown code: error with supported_countries); include_eu adds EU-wide actions. Free, read-only.

changed_since.description: Only actions updated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

country.description: Optional ISO country code filter, e.g. ES, DE, EE, EU.

include_eu.description: With country: also return EU-wide actions. Default false.

name: list_actions
